title: eval-harness: add per-prompt quality CI hook + gating for prompt-set regressions
author: Asha Patel
description: Add a CI hook that runs per-prompt quality checks against the eval-harness prompt sets and enforces an opt-in gating policy. Motivation: teams have observed silent quality regressions when large model rollouts change prompt-level behavior; adding a lightweight, per-prompt quality CI hook lets PRs fail fast on clustered regressions while keeping overall CI cost low. This change includes: (1) a new lightweight runner that samples per-prompt metrics and compares against baseline thresholds, (2) gating behavior configurable via .eval/config.yaml and repo-level labels, (3) an opt-in threshold override for canary/dedicated releases, and (4) CI job definitions for Github Actions and an internal CircleCI compatibility shim. Checklist: - [x] implement per-prompt runner and metric exporters - [x] add gating config and documentation - [x] add unit + integration tests for runner - [x] wire into Github Actions matrix job - [x] doc: how to opt-in/out and interpret failures Related: ENG-2143 (prompt-set monitoring), ENG-2178 (canary rollout gating).
commits: Initial per-prompt-runner implementation and core metric comparisons

release_notes: Adds per-prompt quality CI hook to eval-harness. Teams can opt-in to gating prompt-set regressions via .eval/config.yaml. Provides default thresholds and docs for threshold tuning.
how_to_test: Run `pytest eval-harness/tests/test_per_prompt_runner.py` and trigger the Github Actions workflow file `eval-harness/ci/github/per_prompt_quality.yml` using the workflow_dispatch event. To validate gating behavior, modify defaults.yaml to lower the per_prompt_score_drop and run the runner against the 'core' prompt set in test fixtures.
notes_for_ops: Ops: the job exports statsd metrics: eval.per_prompt.score_drop and eval.per_prompt.failed_prompts; tag with repo and prompt_set. For high-volume repos, increase sample size in .eval/config.yaml to reduce variance.
